$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — Urban Battle L2 (Bradley variant): hit but drives through with the squad still aboard. Judge (1) the vehicle drives its route, (2) the charge goes off only with it within 15 m (take: blast at 21.47 s), (3) it pushes through (PushThrough) with all five still aboard, (4) it ends 100 m past the charge (y > 300) and its route resumes. The 'halt' alternative is not asserted. Feature (10 units, no fight): golden every 10.
